save_conversion_result_to_zip: save a ConversionAssets object to a ZIP archive with version, status, errors, pages, timings, confidence, and document JSON files
load_conversion_result_from_zip: load a ConversionAssets object from a previously saved ZIP archive containing version, status, errors, pages, timings, confidence, and document JSON files
create_input_document_from_path: create an InputDocument from a file path with format detection, file hashing, and backend initialization for document conversion
create_input_document_from_stream: create an InputDocument from a BytesIO stream with filename, format detection, and backend initialization for document conversion
get_docling_version_info: get a DoclingVersion object containing versions of docling, docling-core, docling-ibm-models, docling-parse, platform, and Python implementation details
